# origin pvs commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from `origin --help` of the release scripts/origin-cli.version pins (v1.20.1).
     Do not edit by hand: fix the help text in origincloudhq/cli, or scripts/cli_reference_overrides.yml, and rerun. -->

This page lists every `origin pvs` command. Attaching a volume to an instance is an `origin compute` command; see [`create-volume-attachment`](../../compute/reference/cli.md#create-volume-attachment).

## origin pvs

Persistent volume service: volumes, snapshots and storage classes. Resource names are given as their parts (`--project`, `--zone`, `--volume`), or the resource's flag takes a whole name; `--project` and `--zone` default to the profile's `default-project` and `default-zone`.

Every `origin pvs` command also accepts:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--endpoint <URL>` | Base URL to send the calls to, such as a test server's, instead of the service's own host: `https://pvs.origincloudapis.eu`, or `https://pvs.{region}.origincloudapis.eu` when the profile names a `region`. It must be `https://`, or `http://` to this machine (`localhost`, `127.0.0.1`, `[::1]`). A list without `--zone` looks up the zones at the location service, not here; `ORIGINCLOUD_LOCATION_ENDPOINT` sends that lookup elsewhere. Environment variable: `ORIGINCLOUD_PVS_ENDPOINT`. |

### get-snapshot

Returns a snapshot.

```sh
origin pvs get-snapshot [OPTIONS] --snapshot <SNAPSHOT>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--snapshot <SNAPSHOT>` | yes | The snapshot to return. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--zone`, or its whole name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/snapshots/{snapshot}`. |

### list-snapshots

Lists the snapshots in a zone, oldest first. Deleted snapshots aren't listed. For every zone's snapshots, list the zones whose `services` name `pvs` with the location service (`location.origincloudapis.eu`), then each zone's snapshots.

```sh
origin pvs list-snapshots [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone to list, such as `eu-central1-az1`. Without it, every zone that offers the service is listed, in catalog order; the profile's `default-zone` isn't used for lists. |
| `--page-size <PAGE_SIZE>` | no | The most snapshots to return; the server clamps it, and 0 means its default. Without `--page-size` or `--page-token`, every page is listed. Either needs `--zone`. |
| `--page-token <PAGE_TOKEN>` | no | A previous response's `nextPageToken`, for the page after it. Without `--page-size` or `--page-token`, every page is listed. Either needs `--zone`. |

### create-snapshot

Takes a snapshot of a volume. The operation is done once the copy is `COMPLETED`, or failed once it is `ERROR`.

```sh
origin pvs create-snapshot [OPTIONS] --source-volume <VOLUME>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--source-volume <VOLUME>` | yes | The volume copied, in the same project and zone. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--zone`, or its whole name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/volumes/{volume}`. |
| `--tag <KEY=VALUE>` | no | Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows. As KEY=VALUE; repeat for more. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id returns the first request's operation instead of taking a second snapshot. One is generated when not given. |
| `--no-wait` | no | Print the operation as soon as the API accepts it, instead of waiting until it is done. |

### update-snapshot

Changes a snapshot's tags.

```sh
origin pvs update-snapshot [OPTIONS] --snapshot <SNAPSHOT> <--tag <KEY=VALUE>|--no-tags>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--snapshot <SNAPSHOT>` | yes | The snapshot to change. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--zone`, or its whole name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/snapshots/{snapshot}`. |
| `--tag <KEY=VALUE>` | one of `--tag`, `--no-tags` | Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows. As KEY=VALUE; repeat for more. Replaces all of them, so give every one to keep; `--no-tags` removes them all. Left as they are when neither is given. |
| `--no-tags` | one of `--tag`, `--no-tags` | Remove all of its tags. |

### delete-snapshot

Deletes a snapshot. It must be `COMPLETED` or `ERROR`, and unprotected. The operation is done once the snapshot is `DELETED`.

```sh
origin pvs delete-snapshot [OPTIONS] --snapshot <SNAPSHOT>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--snapshot <SNAPSHOT>` | yes | The snapshot to delete. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--zone`, or its whole name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/snapshots/{snapshot}`. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id returns the first request's operation. One is generated when not given. |
| `--no-wait` | no | Print the operation as soon as the API accepts it, instead of waiting until it is done. |
| `--yes` | no | Confirm an irreversible operation: a delete, or a change the help says can't be undone. Without it the command refuses, and says what it would have done, before sending anything. |

### protect-snapshot

Protects a snapshot, so it can be the source of volumes and images and can't be deleted. The operation is done once it is `PROTECTED`.

```sh
origin pvs protect-snapshot [OPTIONS] --snapshot <SNAPSHOT>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--snapshot <SNAPSHOT>` | yes | The snapshot to protect; it must be `COMPLETED`. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--zone`, or its whole name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/snapshots/{snapshot}`. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id returns the first request's operation. One is generated when not given. |
| `--no-wait` | no | Print the operation as soon as the API accepts it, instead of waiting until it is done. |

### unprotect-snapshot

Unprotects a snapshot, so it can be deleted. Refused with `FAILED_PRECONDITION` while an image is built from it or a volume not `DELETED` was created from it; delete those first. The operation is done once it is `UNPROTECTED`.

```sh
origin pvs unprotect-snapshot [OPTIONS] --snapshot <SNAPSHOT>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--snapshot <SNAPSHOT>` | yes | The snapshot to unprotect; it must be `COMPLETED`, or `ERROR` so that it can then be deleted. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--zone`, or its whole name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/snapshots/{snapshot}`. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id returns the first request's operation. One is generated when not given. |
| `--no-wait` | no | Print the operation as soon as the API accepts it, instead of waiting until it is done. |

### get-storage-class

Returns a storage class.

```sh
origin pvs get-storage-class [OPTIONS] --storage-class <STORAGE_CLASS>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--storage-class <STORAGE_CLASS>` | yes | The class to return, `storageClasses/{storage_class}`. Its id, or its whole name, `storageClasses/{storage_class}`. |

### list-storage-classes

Lists every storage class, including those not yet on sale: check `available` before selecting one.

```sh
origin pvs list-storage-classes [OPTIONS]
```

This command takes no options of its own.

```sh

```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--volume <VOLUME>` | yes | The volume to return. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--zone`, or its whole name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/volumes/{volume}`. |

### list-volumes

Lists the volumes in a zone, oldest first. Deleted volumes aren't listed. For every zone's volumes, list the zones whose `services` name `pvs` with the location service (`location.origincloudapis.eu`), then each zone's volumes.

```sh
origin pvs list-volumes [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone to list, such as `eu-central1-az1`. Without it, every zone that offers the service is listed, in catalog order; the profile's `default-zone` isn't used for lists. |
| `--page-size <PAGE_SIZE>` | no | The most volumes to return; the server clamps it, and 0 means its default. Without `--page-size` or `--page-token`, every page is listed. Either needs `--zone`. |
| `--page-token <PAGE_TOKEN>` | no | A previous response's `nextPageToken`, for the page after it. Without `--page-size` or `--page-token`, every page is listed. Either needs `--zone`. |

### create-volume

Creates a volume, empty or as a copy of a snapshot. The operation is done once the volume is `AVAILABLE`, or failed once it is `ERROR`.

```sh
origin pvs create-volume [OPTIONS] --size-gib <SIZE_GIB>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--size-gib <SIZE_GIB>` | yes | The size in GiB, at least 1. Growing it resizes the volume; it never shrinks. |
| `--storage-class <STORAGE_CLASS>` | no | The storage class, `storageClasses/{storage_class}`. The default class when left empty. Its id, or its whole name, `storageClasses/{storage_class}`. |
| `--source-snapshot <SNAPSHOT>` | no | The snapshot the volume was created from, in the same project and zone; empty for an empty volume. The volume is at least the snapshot's size. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--zone`, or its whole name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/snapshots/{snapshot}`. |
| `--tag <KEY=VALUE>` | no | Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows. As KEY=VALUE; repeat for more. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id returns the first request's operation instead of creating a second volume. One is generated when not given. |
| `--no-wait` | no | Print the operation as soon as the API accepts it, instead of waiting until it is done. |

### import-volume

Creates a volume whose initial content is a disk image the platform downloads. The operation is done once the volume is `AVAILABLE`.

```sh
origin pvs import-volume [OPTIONS] --size-gib <SIZE_GIB> --source-url <SOURCE_URL>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--size-gib <SIZE_GIB>` | yes | The size in GiB, at least 1. Growing it resizes the volume; it never shrinks. |
| `--storage-class <STORAGE_CLASS>` | no | The storage class, `storageClasses/{storage_class}`. The default class when left empty. Its id, or its whole name, `storageClasses/{storage_class}`. |
| `--tag <KEY=VALUE>` | no | Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows. As KEY=VALUE; repeat for more. |
| `--source-url <SOURCE_URL>` | yes | The URL of the disk image, which the platform downloads over HTTP or HTTPS: it must be reachable from the platform. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id returns the first request's operation instead of importing twice. One is generated when not given. |
| `--no-wait` | no | Print the operation as soon as the API accepts it, instead of waiting until it is done. |

### update-volume

Changes a volume's size or tags. A larger `--size-gib` grows the volume, attached or not; it never shrinks, and the size it already has changes nothing. The operation is done once the volume reports the new size.

```sh
origin pvs update-volume [OPTIONS] --volume <VOLUME> <--size-gib <SIZE_GIB>|--tag <KEY=VALUE>|--no-tags>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--volume <VOLUME>` | yes | The volume to change. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--zone`, or its whole name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/volumes/{volume}`. |
| `--size-gib <SIZE_GIB>` | one of `--size-gib`, `--tag`, `--no-tags` | The size in GiB, at least 1. Growing it resizes the volume; it never shrinks. Left as it is when not given. A volume never shrinks back, and its larger size is charged. Setting it needs `--yes`. |
| `--tag <KEY=VALUE>` | one of `--size-gib`, `--tag`, `--no-tags` | Labels of your own, at most 50. The `origin:name` tag is the name the console shows. As KEY=VALUE; repeat for more. Replaces all of them, so give every one to keep; `--no-tags` removes them all. Left as they are when neither is given. |
| `--no-tags` | one of `--size-gib`, `--tag`, `--no-tags` | Remove all of its tags. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id returns the first request's operation instead of changing the volume again. One is generated when not given. |
| `--no-wait` | no | Print the operation as soon as the API accepts it, instead of waiting until it is done. |
| `--yes` | no | Confirm an irreversible operation: a delete, or a change the help says can't be undone. Without it the command refuses, and says what it would have done, before sending anything. |

### delete-volume

Deletes a volume. It must not be attached, and none of its snapshots may be left. The operation is done once the volume is `DELETED`.

```sh
origin pvs delete-volume [OPTIONS] --volume <VOLUME>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--volume <VOLUME>` | yes | The volume to delete. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--zone`, or its whole name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/volumes/{volume}`. |
| `--request-id <REQUEST_ID>` | no | A UUID; a repeat with the same id returns the first request's operation. One is generated when not given. |
| `--no-wait` | no | Print the operation as soon as the API accepts it, instead of waiting until it is done. |
| `--yes` | no | Confirm an irreversible operation: a delete, or a change the help says can't be undone. Without it the command refuses, and says what it would have done, before sending anything. |

### get-operation

Returns an operation as it is now. The operation is one an `origin pvs` command answered with, such as the one `--no-wait` prints.

```sh
origin pvs get-operation [OPTIONS] --operation <OPERATION>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--operation <OPERATION>` | yes | The operation. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--zone`, or its whole name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/operations/{operation}`. |

### wait-operation

Waits until an operation is done or `--timeout` has passed, whichever comes first, and returns it as it is then. It only reads, so a client may repeat it after a transport error. The operation is one an `origin pvs` command answered with, such as the one `--no-wait` prints. Without `--timeout`, the command waits until the operation is done; Ctrl-C stops the waiting, not the operation. It prints the operation, and exits with status 1 when the operation failed, or isn't done when `--timeout` passes.

```sh
origin pvs wait-operation [OPTIONS] --operation <OPERATION>
```

| Option | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--project <PROJECT>` | no | The project, such as `my-project-123`. `ORIGINCLOUD_PROJECT`, else the profile's `default-project`, when not given. |
| `--zone <ZONE>` | no | The zone, such as `eu-central1-az1`. `ORIGINCLOUD_ZONE`, else the profile's `default-zone`, when not given. |
| `--operation <OPERATION>` | yes | The operation. Its id, completed with `--project` and `--zone`, or its whole name, `projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/operations/{operation}`. |
| `--timeout <DURATION>` | no | How long to wait for the operation, such as `30s` or `5m`. Without it, the command waits as long as the operation takes. When it passes first, the command prints the operation as it is and exits with status 1. |
